# نَتَمَنْطَقُ (natamanṭaqu) /na.ta.man.tˤa.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
# نُتَمَنْطَقُ (nutamanṭaqu) /nu.ta.man.tˤa.qu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
# نَتَمَنْطَقَ (natamanṭaqa) /na.ta.man.tˤa.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
# نُتَمَنْطَقَ
